cohort: Patients with complicated genital fistulae at Sant Parmanand Hospital, Delhi, from September 2008 to August 2018.
finding: A 100% success rate was achieved with the first attempt of reparative surgery or ureteric stenting for complicated genital fistulae, with minimal complications, after a mean follow-up of 5.8 years for obstetric fistulae and 7.3 years for post-operative fistulae.
followup_time: 5.8 years for obstetric fistulae and 7.3 years for post-operative fistulae
